title: 第125章 想过修仙吗第124章 你这样很不好
slug: 不是吧这魔修过于正义
content_zh:
“单方面死缠烂打怎么了？”
钱音音撇了撇嘴，很是不服气地小声嘀咕道：“勇敢追求自己喜欢的人有什么错？再说了，爹，你还好意思教训我呢！我可听娘说过，当初你为了娶她，天天带着人在外公家门口死皮赖脸地堵门，赶都赶不走。我这分明就是家学渊源，深得你的真传！”
“你……你这倒霉孩子！”
钱多多被亲闺女当众揭了老底，顿时老脸一红，急得直跳脚：“你懂个屁！爹当年那叫精诚所至，金石为开！再说了，这男人跟女人能一样吗？！”
“确实不一样！”
钱音音深以为然地点了点头：“俗话说得好，男追女，隔层山；女追男，隔层纱呀！爹，你想想，你当年隔着一座大山都能用死皮赖脸的战术给挖通了，我这只不过是捅破一层薄薄的面纱而已嘛！”
“所以我觉得，只要我再努点力，加把劲儿，一定可以拿下燕哥哥的！”
“……”
钱多多听得两眼一黑，只觉得一股逆血直冲天灵盖：“什么山啊纱的！你一个清清白白的大姑娘，都是在哪里学来的这些乱七八糟的歪理邪说？！”
钱音音毫不犹豫地转身，纤纤玉指直接指向了旁边的周龙：“都是周师兄跟我说的呀！”
“噗！”
旁边正假装看风景的周龙，刚咽下去的一口茶水差点直接喷出来。
“啊？我吗？”
周龙一脸懵逼。
他只是一个母胎单身，一心追寻大道的剑修啊！
钱多多看了周龙一眼，他知道自己女儿什么德性，定然是乱说的，再说了就算是真的他也不敢跟仙长逼逼赖赖的啊。
于是他直接一把拧住钱音音的耳朵：“小兔崽子，还学会撒谎了！今天非得好好教训你不可。”
“痛痛痛！爹撒手！爹我错啦！”
钱音音龇牙咧嘴地被拉走了。
周龙也连忙跟上。

原本喧闹了一整晚的平安饭馆，终于重新恢复了宁静。
直到确认那三人的背影彻底消失在长街的拐角，大堂的门柱后面，才鬼鬼祟祟地探出了一颗脑袋。
正是刚才一直躲在角落里偷偷吃瓜看戏的小豆子。
小豆子左顾右盼了一番，一溜小跑凑到燕倾身边：“掌柜的，这钱姑娘去仙门逛了一圈，不仅没改性子，怎么感觉这粘人的功力还见长了？她这一回来，接下来你又有的头疼咯！”
小豆子可是亲眼见识过这位首富千金当初的恐怖杀伤力。
那死缠烂打的劲头，简直比后厨灶台上常年洗不掉的油垢还要难缠，当初可是把自家掌柜烦得连午觉都睡不安生，动不动就得躲出去。
话音刚落。
一旁正在角落里一丝不苟擦拭着板凳的叶孤鸿，突然停下了手中的动作。
他板着脸说道：“掌柜的，这钱家千金屡次三番来此胡搅蛮缠，扰您清修，简直是胆大妄为。要不要我今夜便去钱府……警告她一番？”
燕倾笑着抿了一口清茶：“行了，收起你那副要杀人的架势。一个小姑娘而已，别大惊小怪的。”
随后他看向小豆子，突然话锋一转：“那个，小豆子啊。”
“哎！我在！”
小豆子立马站直了身子。
燕倾笑着问：“你跟着我这么久，有没有想过，修仙？”
“修…修仙？”
content_en:
"What's wrong with the unilateral stalking?"
Qian Yinyin curled her lips and murmured unconvincingly: "What's wrong with pursuing the person you like bravely? Besides, dad, you have the nerve to teach me a lesson! I heard my mother say that in order to marry her, you and your people shamelessly blocked the door of my grandpa's house every day and couldn't drive her away. I clearly have a family background, and I have learned from you!"
"You...you unlucky kid!"
Qian Duoduo was exposed in public by his daughter, and his old face turned red immediately, and he jumped up and down with anxiety: "You know nothing! My father used to be sincere, and his fortune was as good as gold! Besides, can this man be the same as a woman?!"
"It's really different!"
Qian Yinyin nodded with deep approval: "As the saying goes, when a man chases a woman, there is a mountain between them; when a woman chases a man, there is a veil between them! Dad, think about it, back then you were able to dig through a huge mountain with shameless tactics. I just pierced a thin veil!"
"So I feel that as long as I work harder and put in more effort, I will definitely be able to win over Brother Yan!"
"..."
Qian Duoduo's eyes darkened when he heard this, and he felt a surge of blood rushing straight to Tian Linggai: "What kind of Shanahsha! Where did you, an innocent girl, learn all these nonsense and heresies?!"
Qian Yinyin turned around without hesitation and pointed her slender jade finger directly at Zhou Long next to her: "Senior Brother Zhou told me this!"
"Poof!"
Zhou Long, who was pretending to look at the scenery next to him, almost spit out the sip of tea he just swallowed.
"Huh? Me?"
Zhou Long looked confused.
He is just a sword cultivator who is single and devoted to pursuing the great path!
Qian Duoduo glanced at Zhou Long. He knew that his daughter's virtue must be nonsense. Besides, even if it was true, he would not dare to force the immortal to do anything about it.
So he pinched Qian Yinyin's ears and said, "You little bastard, you've learned to lie! I have to teach you a lesson today."
"It hurts! Daddy, let go! Daddy, I was wrong!"
Qian Yinyin was pulled away with a grin on her face.
Zhou Long also quickly followed.
The Ping An Restaurant, which had been noisy all night, finally regained its tranquility.
It wasn't until they confirmed that the three people's backs had completely disappeared at the corner of the long street and behind the doorpost of the lobby that a head sneakily popped out.
It was Xiaodouzi who had been hiding in the corner just now secretly eating melons and watching the show.
Xiaodouzi looked around for a while, then trotted up to Yan Qing: "Shopkeeper, this girl Qian went to Xianmen for a walk. Not only has she not changed her temper, why does she feel that her clinging skills have improved? Now that she is back, you will have another headache!"
Xiaodouzi had seen with his own eyes the terrifying lethality of the richest man's daughter.
That persistent pursuit was even more difficult to deal with than the grease stains on the kitchen stove that could not be washed away all year round. At first, it annoyed the shopkeeper so much that he couldn't even take a nap and had to hide out at every turn.
The words just fell.
Ye Guhong, who was meticulously wiping the bench in the corner, suddenly stopped what he was doing.
He said with a straight face: "Shopkeeper, this daughter of the Qian family has come here repeatedly to mess around and disturb your Qingxiu. It is simply audacious. Do you want me to go to the Qian Mansion tonight... to warn her?"
Yan Qing smiled and took a sip of tea: "Okay, put away your murderous attitude. She's just a little girl, don't make a fuss."
Then he looked at Xiaodouzi and suddenly changed the subject: "Well, Xiaodouzi."
"Hey! I'm here!"
Xiaodouzi immediately stood up straight.
Yan Qing asked with a smile: "You have been following me for so long, have you ever thought about cultivating immortality?"
"Cultivation...cultivation to immortality?"
